Employee contributions (about 20.6% to 20.9% of gross, checked against the Urssaf mon-entreprise engine, which gave about 0.1% more): CSG and CRDS 9.7% on 98.25% of gross, old-age 6.9% up to the 48,060 EUR ceiling plus 0.4% on all pay, Agirc-Arrco 3.15% up to the ceiling and 8.64% above it, CEG 0.86% and 1.08%, CET 0.14% above the ceiling, APEC 0.024%; no employee unemployment contribution. Pay sources agree on the shape. Hays 2026 national full stack bands: 40-46k (0 to 3 yrs), 46-52k (3 to 5), 52-58k (5 to 8), 55-68k (8+). TPC 2026 Paris medians including variable pay: 42k (0 to 2 yrs), 50k (3 to 5), 59k (6 to 9). Levels.fyi shows a Paris-area median total pay of 66,990 EUR from 786 salaries across all levels, which leans toward large tech employers.

Posted ranges: Theodo fullstack 40-50k, Extia Java 38-46k, Unitech confirmed 43-45k, Michael Page C#/.NET 45-55k, Warren Walter React/Java 55-65k, W HUB Node/TypeScript 60-70k, Altrion seniors 50-80k. Few ads state a level, so I matched levels to the Hays and TPC bands. Junior is the thinnest level. Bonus rates (3%, 5%, 7%) are estimates; no source gave a developer bonus figure.

Many software firms and consultancies are under the Syntec agreement (my understanding, not checked per firm), which sets minimum pay for engineers and managers (cadres). Its engineer and manager minimums, from the 2024 accord as reproduced by ma-ccn.com and not confirmed as the latest, run from 2,135 EUR a month at position 1.1 to 3,650 at position 3.1.

Impatriate regime: a new graduate can qualify if hired directly from abroad and not French tax resident in the five calendar years before starting; there is no minimum experience. It exempts 30% of pay for up to 8 years. Anyone who was a French tax resident in any of those five years does not qualify. Not in the table; my rough estimate is up to about 275 EUR a month more net at the mid level.

Cheaper nearby towns: 2-room asking rents average 1,118 in Montreuil and 987 in Saint-Denis against 1,663 in Paris (123 Loger, March 2026). A pass for zones 1 to 5 costs 90.80 whatever the distance, so living further out adds little transit cost. Numbeo's 1-bedroom figures (1,035 outside, 1,414 centre) sit below the 123 Loger Paris 2-room average.
